claims.statement: Operator's own description (README): an MIT, local-first multi-agent desktop app; the Commander plans the work and coordinates 16 built-in specialist agents and the external CLI agents Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes-Agent run as local sessions; packaged app for macOS 12+ and Windows 10+, Linux x64/arm64 only by running from source; an agent marketplace lists 30+ agents.
claims.quote: Its Commander turns your goal into to-dos and coordinates 16 built-in specialist agents — plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes-Agent — to deliver finished files.
methods: GitHub API /repos/Orkas-AI/Orkas/readme (raw README.md, sections FAQ, Requirements, Run from source)

claims.statement: Operator's own example agent: DeepResearcher scopes a research question, gathers and checks sources, compares conflicting evidence and delivers findings with citations and limitations.
claims.quote: DeepResearcher defines the scope, gathers and checks sources, compares conflicting evidence, and delivers findings with citations and limitations.

claims.statement: Pricing page: the Free plan is $0 with 500 lifetime credits; paid plans add monthly credits for the managed models and services (Lite from $11.99 a month with 5,000 credits, Pro from $19.99 a month with 10,000 credits). The page currently carries the notice that its dev mode uses a Stripe sandbox.
claims.quote: Credits cover models, web search, images, video, speech and other services.
methods: curl -sL -A "<Chrome UA>" https://orkas.ai/pricing/ (HTTP 200; Free $0, Lite $11.99, Pro $19.99 per month; notice "Dev mode uses Stripe sandbox. Test cards only; no real charge.")
